response.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), shares AS (SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM grp) AS share FROM grp), base AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS baseline FROM shares) SELECT s.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, s.cnt AS behaviour_record_count, s.share AS share, s.share - b.baseline AS share_above_baseline FROM shares s CROSS JOIN base b WHERE s.share > b.baseline ORDER BY s.share DESC

assumptions.assumption: Records whose ordertypedist is NULL form their own group (a NULL group in the output is possible), and that group counts as one mix in the baseline average.
Share is computed against the total of matched (inner-joined) behaviour records across all mixes, including the NULL group.
The baseline is the unweighted average of the per-mix shares (equals 1 divided by the number of mixes), and the output shows share minus baseline as a raw fraction, not a percentage.
